title: Pythia: A Suite for Analyzing Large Language Models Across Training and Scaling

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the WinoBias benchmark to test how the model links gendered pronouns to stereotypical occupations via multiple-choice prompting, and the CrowS-Pairs benchmark to measure if the model assigns lower perplexity to stereotypical sentences compared to anti-stereotypical ones. The authors also use counterfactual data interventions, swapping masculine pronouns for feminine ones during a portion of pretraining, to measure the impact of corpus statistics on these downstream biases.
